subpages.title: Push Buttons / Switches | Carlo Gavazzi Industrial Automation
subpages.desc: Carlo Gavazzi is your source in North America for Ersce Push Buttons, selector switches, key switches, joy sticks, and indicators. These high quality modular switches are perfectly suited for a wide variety of applications. Our switches are available with both plastic and metal rings and are available in flush, extended, and mushroom actuators.
subpages.text: Skip to main content Search Carlo Gavazzi products Search Request Quote Home Products Catalogs Request Quote Contact Us Home Products Push Buttons / Switches Push Buttons / Switches Carlo Gavazzi offers a complete range of push buttons, selector switches, and indicator lights. Gavazzi switches are available with flush, extended, and mushroom heads and in a wide variety of colours - both standard and illuminated. Push buttons are available with either a plastic or metal ring and in versions for 22 mm and 30 mm mounting. Gavazzi selector switches are available with long or short handles. Short handle types are also available in illuminated versions. Gavazzi selector switches are available with either a plastic or metal ring and are available in versions for 22 mm and 30 mm mounting. Carlo Gavazzi also offers a broad selection of indicators lights featuring LED lights with a service life in excess of 100,000 hours. In addition to a wide selection of colours, there are various lens types and styles making them suitable for most applications. Gavazzi even offer dual colour indicators and to top off our range, buzzers and flashing buzzers. subpages.text: Skip to main content Search Carlo Gavazzi products Search Request Quote Home Products Catalogs Request Quote Contact Us Home Products Cam Switches Disconnects Cam Switches Disconnects Carlo Gavazzi offers a comprehensive range of Cam Switches and Rotary Disconnect Switches. Our Disconnect Switches feature Positively-opening contacts and are available with 2, 3, or 4 poles for currents up to 100 Amps. They are also available with built-in fuses for currents up to 32 Amps. Most models can be expanded with additional poles or auxillary contact blocks. Our Cam Switches are available with a wide selection of contact forms and are suitable for currents up to 40 Amps (20 HP @ 480 VAC). subpages.text: Skip to main content Search Carlo Gavazzi products Search Request Quote Home Products Catalogs Request Quote Contact Us Home Products Limit Switches Limit Switches Product Brochure Carlo Gavazzi is your source in North America for Ersce Limit Switches - a comprehensive line of high quality switches perfectly suited for a wide variety of sensing applications. We offer a wide variety of actuating heads and numerous housing sizes in either plastic or metal. Connections are made via a PG 13.5 conduit entry or on some models via a built in cable or M12 connector. Various output configurations are available in slow and snap action. Many models also feature force break contacts. Limit switches are frequently used in position detection on doors and machinery and parts detection on conveyors and assembly lines. subpages.text: Skip to main content Search Carlo Gavazzi products Search Request Quote Home Products Catalogs Request Quote Contact Us Home Products New Products New Products ICS Series Inductive Proximity Sensors & CONB Series Cordsets August 2015 - CARLO GAVAZZI is pleased to announce two new product lines designed specifically for harsh environments. The new ICS Inductive Proximity Sensors meet or exceed IP69K, ECOLAB, and FDA standards. The new CONB Series Cordsets meet or exceed IP69K and ECOLAB standards. Both the ICS Sensors and the CONB Cordsets are perfect for environments where high pressure sprays, high temperatures, or harsh chemicals are present. Press Release ICS Series Sensor Datasheets ICB Series Inductive Proximity Sensors August 2015 - CARLO GAVAZZI is pleased to announce the expansion of the popular ICB Series Inductive Proximity Sensors. New “Extra-Extended” ICB12, ICB18 and ICB30 sensors provide sensing ranges up to three times the sensing distances of standard M12, M18, and M30 cylindrical inductive proximity sensors! In addition, Carlo Gavazzi has responded to feedback received from customers to provide some important enhancements to the ICB line. Browse Products at Gross Automation Contact Us About Carlo Gavazzi Company Overview Carlo Gavazzi is an international group headquartered in Steinhausen, Switzerland , specializing in the design, manufacture, and marketing of electronic equipment for industrial and building automation. The company operates through Carlo Gavazzi Holding AG , a publicly traded company on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SWX: GAV) since 1984. History Founded in 1931 in Milan, Italy, by Carlo Gavazzi, the company was built on a vision of industrial automation when the field was still in its infancy. From those earliest days in Milan, Carlo Gavazzi has grown into a global presence with manufacturing facilities in Italy, Lithuania, Malta, and China.
